parsed.explanation: Trans-specific primary risks dominate: Aug 2026 vigilante mob attacks on trans women tied to officials' framing of LGBTQ+ people as national-defense threats, police venue raids (75 arrested June 2025), and documented raids detaining trans women in rehabilitation centres. Same-sex criminalisation (new penal code extramarital provision, provincial caning Feb 2025, Aceh caning for gender disorder, local fines on trans women) is secondary but is actively used as a police lever, not a dead letter. No working protection or recourse is documented; the 2015/2009 police provisions have no outcomes. A single death-in-custody allegation for a trans traveller, with police denial, is weak on rate but state-implicated. No death penalty or systematic presentation imprisonments are documented, keeping this above 0.15 and nearer the 0.25 sustained-coercion tier, with subnational variation in Aceh/provinces making the mean worse.
